title: 三电压表法测线圈参数
statement: 用“三电压表法”测量一个实际线圈（电阻 r 与电感 L 串联，参数未知）。线圈与已知电阻 R1 = 4 Ω 串联后接正弦电源，ω = 1000 rad/s。
三只理想电压表的读数（有效值）为：V（电源）150 V，V1（R1 两端）40 V，V2（线圈两端）130 V。
求电流 I、线圈的电阻 r 和感抗 X_L，以及线圈吸收的有功功率 P。

questions.explain: R1 是已知电阻：I = U1/R1 = 40/4 = 10 A。

questions.ask: 线圈电阻 r = ?（即线圈阻抗 Z_cd 的实部）
线圈感抗 X_L = ?（即 Z_cd 的虚部）
线圈吸收的有功功率 P = ?
questions.explain: P = I²r = 10² × 5 = 500 W；三表法公式 P = (U² − U1² − U2²)/(2R1) = 4000/8 = 500 W，结果一致。

hints: 以电流 I 为参考相量画相量图：U1 与 I 同相，线圈电压 U2 超前 I 一个角度 φ₂，U = U1 + U2 构成三角形。
三条边的长度就是三个读数，用余弦定理求 φ₂：U² = U1² + U2² + 2U1U2 cos φ₂。
solution: **2. 相量图。** 以 I 为参考：U1 = 40∠0° V；线圈电压 U2 = 130∠φ₂ V（感性，φ₂ > 0）；KVL：U = U1 + U2，三个相量组成三角形，三边长 150、40、130。

en.title: Three-voltmeter method for a coil
statement: A practical coil (resistance r in series with inductance L, both unknown) is measured by the "three-voltmeter method": the coil is put in series with a known resistor R1 = 4 Ω across a sinusoidal source, ω = 1000 rad/s.
The three ideal voltmeters read (rms): V (source) 150 V, V1 (across R1) 40 V, V2 (across the coil) 130 V.
Find the current I, the coil's resistance r and reactance X_L, and the real power P absorbed by the coil.

questions.explain: R1 is known: I = U1/R1 = 40/4 = 10 A.

questions.ask: Coil resistance r = ? (the real part of the coil impedance Z_cd)
Coil reactance X_L = ? (the imaginary part of Z_cd)
Real power absorbed by the coil, P = ?
questions.explain: P = I²r = 10² × 5 = 500 W; the three-voltmeter formula P = (U² − U1² − U2²)/(2R1) = 4000/8 = 500 W gives the same.

hints: Draw the phasor diagram with I as reference: U1 is in phase with I, the coil voltage U2 leads I by some angle φ₂, and U = U1 + U2 forms a triangle.
The three sides are the three readings; use the law of cosines for φ₂: U² = U1² + U2² + 2U1U2 cos φ₂.
|Z_coil| = U2/I, r = |Z| cos φ₂, X_L = |Z| sin φ₂.
solution: **1. Current.** R1 is known, I = U1/R1 = 40/4 = **10 A**.
**2. Phasor diagram.** With I as reference: U1 = 40∠0° V; the coil voltage U2 = 130∠φ₂ V (inductive, φ₂ > 0); KVL: U = U1 + U2, so the three phasors form a triangle with sides 150, 40, 130.
**5. Power.** P = I²r = **500 W**, which also equals U2·I·cos φ₂ = 130 × 10 × 5/13 = 500 W.
